item.text: {"paper_id":"paper041","profile_id":"oncology","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"These findings highlight spatially localized cytotoxic cell exhaustion as a key immune evasion mechanism in HPV-negative HNSCC and underscore the value of integrating spatial and single-cell data to reveal therapeutic vulnerabilities.","rationale":"The study directly addresses cancer progression through tumor-specific immune changes and cytotoxic cell exhaustion, identifying immune evasion mechanisms and potential therapeutic vulnerabilities in HPV-negative HNSCC.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
